  /* ---------- chapter readout: where am I in the journey ----------------- */
  /* Continuity device. Without it, eight scenes still read as eight sections;
     with it the page keeps telling you which beat you are in and how far
     through the arc that is. */
  var chapters = gsap.utils.toArray('section[data-chapter]');
  var num = document.getElementById('chNum'),
    name = document.getElementById('chName'),
    chBar = document.getElementById('chBar'),
    readout = document.getElementById('chapterReadout');

  if (chapters.length && readout) {
    var last = chapters.length - 1;
    chapters.forEach(function (sec) {
      var i = parseInt(sec.getAttribute('data-chapter'), 10);
      var label = sec.getAttribute('data-chapter-name');
      var activate = function () {

   FLUSH — smoother first, then every queued section, then refresh.
   Runs last in <body>.

/* Entry point, called at the very end of <body>.

   Setup waits for the webfont, and that wait is not cosmetic. SplitText runs
   with autoSplit, so when Montserrat swaps in it re-splits every headline and
   replaces those nodes. If a pinned chapter has already been built, its
   heading is living inside a ScrollTrigger pin-spacer at that moment — and the
   next refresh throws `NotFoundError: insertBefore … node is no longer a child
   of this node` while unwrapping it. The throw lands between the revert and
   the re-apply, so the spacers are gone, the triggers keep their old start/end
   values, and the document is silently thousands of pixels shorter than
   ScrollTrigger believes. Every scrollTo then lands in the wrong chapter and
   the pins look like they never scrub. Splitting before anything is pinned
   removes the race entirely.

   The race is against a timeout, not just the promise: a font that never
   arrives must not cost the visitor the whole page. */
function wzFlush() {
  var ready =
    document.fonts && document.fonts.ready
      ? Promise.race([
          document.fonts.ready,
          new Promise(function (r) { setTimeout(r, 1800); }),
        ])
      : Promise.resolve();
  ready.then(wzBoot, wzBoot);
}

function wzBoot() {
  var W = window.WZ;
  document.documentElement.classList.add('wz-ready');

  if (!W || !W.ok) {
    /* GSAP missing: paint everything so the page is still readable and the
       offer is still reachable. */
    /* Chapter-tag rules and pinned scenes are pre-staged in CSS at their
       "not yet" value; without motion nothing would ever move them off it. */
    document.documentElement.classList.add('wz-static');
    document.querySelectorAll('[data-rv],[data-split],[data-wipe]').forEach(function (el) {
      el.style.opacity = '1';
      el.style.clipPath = 'none';
    });
    document.querySelectorAll('[data-count]').forEach(paintFinal);
    /* Scroll-scrubbed figures are driven by page.js, which never runs here.
       Without this the stat band reads "0.0%" to every visitor who asks for
       reduced motion — motion off must never mean content off. */
    document.querySelectorAll('[data-scrub-count]').forEach(paintFinal);
    return;
  }

  gsap.registerPlugin(ScrollTrigger, ScrollToPlugin);
  if (window.ScrollSmoother) gsap.registerPlugin(ScrollSmoother);
  if (window.SplitText) gsap.registerPlugin(SplitText);

  if (W.reduced) {
    /* Chapter-tag rules and pinned scenes are pre-staged in CSS at their
       "not yet" value; without motion nothing would ever move them off it. */
    document.documentElement.classList.add('wz-static');
    document.querySelectorAll('[data-rv],[data-split],[data-wipe]').forEach(function (el) {
      el.style.opacity = '1';
      el.style.clipPath = 'none';
    });
    document.querySelectorAll('[data-count]').forEach(paintFinal);
    /* Scroll-scrubbed figures are driven by page.js, which never runs here.
       Without this the stat band reads "0.0%" to every visitor who asks for
       reduced motion — motion off must never mean content off. */
    document.querySelectorAll('[data-scrub-count]').forEach(paintFinal);
    return; // no smoother, no triggers, no pins
  }

  document.body.classList.add('wz-motion');

  if (window.ScrollSmoother) {
    try {
      W.smoother = ScrollSmoother.create({
        wrapper: '#smooth-wrapper',
        content: '#smooth-content',
        smooth: 1.05,
        effects: false,
        smoothTouch: false,
        normalizeScroll: false,
        ignoreMobileResize: true,
      });
    } catch (e) {
      console.warn('ScrollSmoother unavailable', e);
    }
  }

  W.flush();

  /* Anchors route through the smoother, or pinned sections land in the wrong
     place. */
  document.querySelectorAll('a[href^="#"]').forEach(function (a) {
    a.addEventListener('click', function (e) {
      var id = a.getAttribute('href');
      if (!id || id.length < 2) return;
      var t = document.querySelector(id);
      if (!t) return;
      e.preventDefault();
      if (W.smoother) W.smoother.scrollTo(t, true, 'top 80px');
      else gsap.to(window, { duration: 1, scrollTo: { y: t, offsetY: 80 }, ease: 'power2.inOut' });
    });
  });

  /* Images can still land after this, and a late image changes the height of
     everything below it, so pinned scenes need one more measurement once the
     page has finished loading. Deferred a frame and guarded: a refresh that
     throws must not take the page's scroll geometry down with it. */
  window.addEventListener('load', function () {
    requestAnimationFrame(function () {
      try {
        ScrollTrigger.refresh();
      } catch (e) {
        console.warn('ScrollTrigger refresh skipped', e);
      }
    });
  });
}

  var dec = parseInt(el.getAttribute('data-decimals') || '0', 10);
  var value = el.getAttribute('data-count') || el.getAttribute('data-scrub-count');
  el.textContent =
    (el.getAttribute('data-prefix') || '') +
    parseFloat(value).toLocaleString('en-US', {
      minimumFractionDigits: dec,
      maximumFractionDigits: dec,
    }) +
    (el.getAttribute('data-suffix') || '');

<script>
/* ==========================================================================
   IMPLANT LANDING PAGE — chapter choreography
   Asana task 1217133289235653

   Eight chapters. Three of them are scenes the page holds still for:

     01  The Loss      pin + scrub — the sentence is written word by word and
                       the ridge gauge narrows in step with it
     02  The Answer    pin + scrub — a scan line travels the implant, the photo
                       resolves behind it, six reasons light as it passes
     03  The Options   pin + scrub — horizontal travel driven by self.progress

   Everything else arrives and departs: each chapter has an exit timeline on
   start:'top top', end:'bottom top', so leaving one feels like leaving a room.

   All of it runs inside WZ.add(), so it executes after ScrollSmoother exists
   and never runs at all under prefers-reduced-motion.
   ========================================================================== */
WZ.add(function (W) {
  var mm = gsap.matchMedia();

  /* A scrubbed ScrollTrigger with no animation attached never calls onUpdate —
     it has nothing to interpolate. Scrubbing a proxy object gives us a real
     0→1 progress signal we can paint anything from, and returns a cleanup
     function so matchMedia can tear the scene down on a breakpoint change. */
  function scrubScene(config, paint) {
    var proxy = { p: 0 };
    gsap.to(proxy, {
      p: 1,
      ease: 'none',
      scrollTrigger: config,
      onUpdate: function () { paint(proxy.p); },
    });
    /* The cleanup deliberately does NOT kill the tween or its ScrollTrigger.
       Everything created inside a matchMedia callback is already owned by that
       context and reverted for us; killing it here as well double-reverts, and
       the second revert strips the pin spacers out of the layout while the
       triggers keep their old start/end values. The page then looks fine and
       is silently thousands of pixels shorter than ScrollTrigger believes, so
       every scrollTo lands in the wrong chapter. Only the class state is ours
       to reset — GSAP does not know about it. */
    return function () { paint(1); };
  }

  /* ======================================================================
     CHAPTER 00 — ARRIVAL
     ====================================================================== */
  (function () {
    var root = document.getElementById('arrival');
    if (!root) return;

    var tl = gsap.timeline({ delay: 0.12, defaults: { ease: 'power3.out' } });
    var title = document.getElementById('arrivalTitle');
    var split = W.splitLines(title);

    if (split && split.lines && split.lines.length) {
      gsap.set(split.lines, { yPercent: 115 });
      tl.to(split.lines, { yPercent: 0, duration: 1.1, stagger: 0.09, ease: 'power4.out' }, 0);
    } else {
      tl.from(title, { opacity: 0, y: 40, duration: 1 }, 0);
    }
    tl.from(root.querySelector('.chapter-tag'), { opacity: 0, x: -22, duration: 0.85 }, 0.05)
      .from('#arrivalImg', { opacity: 0, scale: 1.12, duration: 1.7 }, 0)
      .from('#quiz', { opacity: 0, y: 40, duration: 1 }, 0.5);

    /* Departure — the chapter recedes and dims into the seam. */
    gsap
      .timeline({ scrollTrigger: { trigger: root, start: 'top top', end: 'bottom top', scrub: 0.5 } })
      .to('#arrivalInner', { yPercent: -12, opacity: 0.2, ease: 'none' }, 0)
      .to('#arrivalImg', { yPercent: 6, scale: 1.1, ease: 'none' }, 0)
      .to('#arrivalVeil', { opacity: 0.75, ease: 'none' }, 0);
  })();

  /* ======================================================================
     CHAPTER 01 — THE LOSS   (pinned, scrubbed)
     ====================================================================== */
  (function () {
    var pin = document.getElementById('lossPin');
    var big = document.getElementById('lossBig');
    var bar = document.getElementById('ridgeBar');
    var num = document.getElementById('lossCount');
    var rail = document.getElementById('lossRail');
    if (!pin || !big || !bar) return;

    var sp = W.splitWords(big);
    var words = sp && sp.words && sp.words.length ? sp.words : null;

    /* The client's own figure. The gauge is the sentence made visible: the
       ridge keeps its full width at the start and ends at what is left. */
    var LOST = 25;

    var paint = function (p) {
      if (words) {
        /* Words brighten one at a time. Each word owns its own colour — two
           tweens writing colour on one word over overlapping ranges flicker,
           because they overwrite each other every frame. */
        var reached = p * (words.length + 2);
        for (var i = 0; i < words.length; i++) {
          var local = Math.min(1, Math.max(0, reached - i));
          words[i].style.color = 'rgba(255,255,255,' + (0.22 + local * 0.78).toFixed(3) + ')';
        }
      }
      /* Never lands exactly on 1: a scrubbed scale that resolves to 1 snaps
         its rasterisation and flickers at the edge. */
      gsap.set(bar, { scaleX: 1 - (LOST / 100) * p });
      if (num) num.textContent = 'Up to ' + Math.round(LOST * p) + '%';
      if (rail) gsap.set(rail, { scaleX: p });
    };

    mm.add('(min-width: 760px)', function () {
      return scrubScene(
        { trigger: pin, start: 'top top', end: '+=130%', pin: true, scrub: 0.3, anticipatePin: 1, invalidateOnRefresh: true },
        paint

    });

       little of it. The same scene plays, driven by the section passing. */
    mm.add('(max-width: 759px)', function () {
      return scrubScene({ trigger: pin, start: 'top 80%', end: 'bottom 55%', scrub: 0.35 }, paint);
    });
  })();

  /* ======================================================================
     CHAPTER 02 — THE ANSWER   (pinned, scrubbed scan)
     ====================================================================== */
  (function () {
    var pin = document.getElementById('answerPin');
    var lit = document.getElementById('scanLit');
    var line = document.getElementById('scanLine');
    var plate = lit && lit.parentElement;
    var reasons = gsap.utils.toArray('[data-reason]');
    var survival = document.getElementById('survivalNum');
    var years = document.getElementById('yearsNum');
    var rail = document.getElementById('answerRail');
    if (!pin || !lit || !plate) return;

    var paint = function (p) {
      var travelled = (p * 100).toFixed(2);
      lit.style.clipPath = 'inset(0 0 ' + (100 - travelled) + '% 0)';
      gsap.set(line, { y: plate.clientHeight * p });
      reasons.forEach(function (row, i) {
        /* Each reason owns a sixth of the travel and lights once the line has
           actually reached it. */
        row.classList.toggle('is-lit', p >= i / reasons.length + 0.02);
      });
      if (survival) survival.textContent = (96.8 * p).toFixed(1) + '%';
      if (years) years.textContent = Math.round(40 * p) + ' yrs';
      if (rail) gsap.set(rail, { scaleX: p });
    };

    mm.add('(min-width: 760px)', function () {
      return scrubScene(
        { trigger: pin, start: 'top top', end: '+=150%', pin: true, scrub: 0.3, anticipatePin: 1, invalidateOnRefresh: true },
        paint
      );
    });
    mm.add('(max-width: 759px)', function () {
      return scrubScene({ trigger: pin, start: 'top 82%', end: 'bottom 60%', scrub: 0.35 }, paint);
    });

    gsap.from('.answer__copy > .chapter-tag, .answer__title, .answer__lede', {
      opacity: 0,
      y: 26,
      duration: 0.9,
      stagger: 0.1,
      ease: 'power3.out',
      scrollTrigger: { trigger: pin, start: 'top 72%' },
    });
  })();

  /* ======================================================================
     CHAPTER 03 — THE OPTIONS   (pinned horizontal journey)
     ====================================================================== */
  (function () {
    var pin = document.getElementById('optionsPin');
    var railTrack = document.getElementById('optionsRail');
    var bar = document.getElementById('optionsBar');
    if (!pin || !railTrack) return;

    /* Travel is whatever the track overhangs the viewport by. Recomputed on
       refresh so it survives resize and late font loading. */
    function distance() {
      return Math.max(0, railTrack.scrollWidth - window.innerWidth + 40);
    }

    mm.add('(min-width: 901px)', function () {
      var cards = gsap.utils.toArray('.opt');
      gsap.to(railTrack, {
        x: function () { return -distance(); },
        ease: 'none',
        scrollTrigger: {
          trigger: pin,
          start: 'top top',
          end: function () { return '+=' + (distance() + window.innerHeight * 0.6); },
          pin: true,
          scrub: 0.3,
          anticipatePin: 1,
          invalidateOnRefresh: true,
          onUpdate: function (self) {
            gsap.set(bar, { scaleX: self.progress });
            /* Whichever panel is nearest the middle of the screen is the one
               being read, so it is the one that comes up to full colour. */
            var mid = window.innerWidth / 2;
            var best = 0,
              bestD = Infinity;
            cards.forEach(function (c, i) {
              var r = c.getBoundingClientRect();
              var d = Math.abs(r.left + r.width / 2 - mid);
              if (d < bestD) { bestD = d; best = i; }
            });
            cards.forEach(function (c, i) { c.classList.toggle('is-centre', i === best); });
          },
        },
      });
      /* No kill here either — see scrubScene. matchMedia already owns
         this tween and its pin; reverting it twice strips the pin
         spacer out of the layout and leaves the trigger's start/end
         pointing at scroll positions the document no longer has. */
      return function () { gsap.set(bar, { scaleX: 1 }); };
    });

    /* Under 900px the rail is a swipe region (see styles.css), so the bar
       tracks the finger instead of the page. */
    mm.add('(max-width: 900px)', function () {
      var onScroll = function () {
        var max = railTrack.scrollWidth - railTrack.clientWidth;
        gsap.set(bar, { scaleX: max > 0 ? railTrack.scrollLeft / max : 1 });
      };
      onScroll();
      railTrack.addEventListener('scroll', onScroll, { passive: true });
      return function () { railTrack.removeEventListener('scroll', onScroll); };
    });
  })();

  /* ======================================================================
     CHAPTERS 04-06 — arrivals and departures
     A section that fades in and then sits there is a band with an animation
     on it. Each of these recedes as you leave it.
     ====================================================================== */
  ['candidacy', 'specialist', 'terms'].forEach(function (id) {
    var sec = document.getElementById(id);
    if (!sec) return;
    /* The range deliberately starts late. These chapters are several screens
       tall, and dimming one while its middle is still being read would cost
       legibility to buy an effect — the recession only touches the tail that
       is already leaving the viewport. */
    gsap.to(sec, {
      opacity: 0.35,
      yPercent: -3,
      ease: 'none',
      scrollTrigger: { trigger: sec, start: 'bottom 30%', end: 'bottom top', scrub: 0.5 },
    });
  });

  /* Case gallery: the four cases rise on a slight diagonal, and each drifts
     against the scroll so the block never sits completely still. */
  gsap.from('#gallery .gallery__item', {
    opacity: 0,
    y: 40,
    duration: 0.9,
    stagger: 0.08,
    ease: 'power3.out',
    scrollTrigger: { trigger: '#gallery', start: 'top 86%' },
  });
  gsap.utils.toArray('#gallery img').forEach(function (img, i) {
    gsap.fromTo(
      img,
      { yPercent: -4 - i, scale: 1.1 },
      {
        yPercent: 4 + i,
        scale: 1.1,
        ease: 'none',
        scrollTrigger: { trigger: '#gallery', start: 'top bottom', end: 'bottom top', scrub: 0.7 },
      }
    );
  });

  /* Financing matrix: rows deal in from the left, so the table is read as a
     sequence of routes rather than a wall of text. */
  gsap.from('#matrixBody tr', {
    opacity: 0,
    x: -30,
    duration: 0.75,
    stagger: 0.09,
    ease: 'power3.out',
    scrollTrigger: { trigger: '#matrixBody', start: 'top 85%' },
  });

  /* ======================================================================
     Service marquee — velocity-reactive
     Speed and direction bend with how fast you are scrolling, so the page
     feels physically connected to the wheel.

    ScrollTrigger.create({
      onUpdate: function (self) {

        vt(gsap.utils.clamp(-7, 7, v === 0 ? 1 : v < 0 ? Math.min(-1, v) : Math.max(1, v)));

<script>
/* ==========================================================================
   IMPLANT LANDING PAGE — offer tokens + lead capture
   Asana task 1217133289235653 (parent 1217040406855578)

   SINGLE SOURCE OF TRUTH for every price and phone number on the page.
   This file runs synchronously at the end of <body>, before wzFlush(), so the
   hero counter animates toward the value set here rather than a hard-coded one.
   ========================================================================== */

var OFFER = {
  /* Single-tooth implant starting price. Currently the figure published on
     grandmissiondentistry.com ("starts at $2,999"). The previous ad company's
     landing page ran "$3,499 with an extra $500 off when paid in full" — if
     Brandklout confirms that offer is live, change this one value. */
  implantPrice: 2999,

  /* The implant campaign's own call-tracking number, as published on the
     vendor original. Per-page numbers are what make paid-channel attribution
     possible, so they stay distinct rather than collapsing to the main line.
     OPEN with Brandklout: if this number belongs to the outgoing ad company
     it may be disconnected at handover, at which point every CTA on this page
     dies silently. Fallback is the practice's main line, (281) 789-8836 /
     +12817898836 — a two-line change here, nowhere else. */
  phoneDisplay: '(281) 747-5929',
  phoneDial: '+12817475929',
};

/* GHL lead destination. Asana task 1217133289235653 requires the lead form to
   live in GoHighLevel. Null until we have the endpoint or embed snippet — the
   form still validates, traps bots and shows its success state, so the page
   reviews end to end without GHL existing. */
var LEAD_ENDPOINT = null;
var THANK_YOU_URL = null; // the thank-you page in this build

(function () {
  /* ---------- tokens ---------------------------------------------------- */
  var priceText = OFFER.implantPrice.toLocaleString('en-US');

  document.querySelectorAll('[data-offer="implant-price-value"]').forEach(function (el) {
    el.textContent = priceText;
  });
  /* The hero figure is a counter: hand the runtime the number, not the string. */
  document.querySelectorAll('[data-offer-count]').forEach(function (el) {
    el.setAttribute('data-count', String(OFFER.implantPrice));
    el.textContent = '$' + priceText;
  });
  document.querySelectorAll('[data-tel]').forEach(function (el) {
    el.textContent = OFFER.phoneDisplay;
  });
  document.querySelectorAll('[data-tel-link]').forEach(function (el) {
    el.setAttribute('href', 'tel:' + OFFER.phoneDial);
  });

  /* ---------- multi-step qualification quiz ----------------------------- */
  var panel = document.getElementById('quiz');
  var form = document.getElementById('leadForm');
  if (!panel || !form) return;

  var steps = Array.prototype.slice.call(form.querySelectorAll('.step'));
  var bar = document.getElementById('quizBar');
  var back = document.getElementById('quizBack');
  var next = document.getElementById('quizNext');
  var progress = panel.querySelector('.panel__progress');
  var current = 0;

  function show(index) {
    current = index;
    steps.forEach(function (s, i) { s.classList.toggle('is-active', i === index); });
    var pct = ((index + 1) / steps.length) * 100;
    bar.style.width = pct + '%';
    progress.setAttribute('aria-valuenow', String(Math.round(pct)));
    back.hidden = index === 0;
    next.querySelector('span').textContent =
      index === steps.length - 1 ? 'Request my free consultation' : 'Continue';
    /* Pinned sections below measure against page height, which changes as the
       panel grows and shrinks. */
    if (window.ScrollTrigger) ScrollTrigger.refresh();
    var first = steps[index].querySelector('input:not([type=hidden])');
    if (first && index > 0) first.focus({ preventScroll: true });
  }

  /* Choosing an option advances automatically — the reason a quiz beats a block
     of fields is that each step costs one tap, not two. */
  steps.forEach(function (step, index) {
    step.querySelectorAll('input[type="radio"]').forEach(function (radio) {
      radio.addEventListener('change', function () {
        if (index < steps.length - 1) setTimeout(function () { show(index + 1); }, 220);
      });
    });
  });

  back.addEventListener('click', function () { show(Math.max(0, current - 1)); });

  form.addEventListener('submit', function (event) {
    event.preventDefault();
    if (!validateStep(steps[current])) return;
    if (current < steps.length - 1) { show(current + 1); return; }
    submitLead();
  });

  function validateStep(step) {
    clearErrors(step);

    var radios = step.querySelectorAll('input[type="radio"]');
    if (radios.length) {
      var chosen = Array.prototype.slice.call(radios).some(function (r) { return r.checked; });
      if (!chosen) {
        var legend = step.querySelector('.step__q');
        legend.style.color = '#c0392b';
        setTimeout(function () { legend.style.color = ''; }, 1800);
        return false;
      }
      return true;
    }

    var ok = true;
    step.querySelectorAll('input[required]').forEach(function (input) {
      var valid =
        input.type === 'checkbox'
          ? input.checked
          : input.value.trim() !== '' && input.checkValidity();
      if (!valid) {
        ok = false;
        input.setAttribute('aria-invalid', 'true');
        var slot = step.querySelector('[data-error-for="' + input.id + '"]');
        if (slot) {
          slot.textContent =
            input.type === 'checkbox'
              ? 'Please agree to the terms so we can contact you.'
              : input.value.trim() === ''
              ? 'This one is required.'
              : 'Please check this is correct.';
        }
      }
    });
    return ok;
  }

  function clearErrors(step) {
    step.querySelectorAll('[aria-invalid]').forEach(function (el) {
      el.removeAttribute('aria-invalid');
    });
    step.querySelectorAll('.field__error').forEach(function (el) { el.textContent = ''; });
  }

  function submitLead() {
    /* Honeypot: a bot fills every field it finds, a patient never sees this one. */
    if (form.company_website && form.company_website.value) return;

    var data = {};
    new FormData(form).forEach(function (value, key) { data[key] = value; });
    data.page = 'implant-landing-page';
    data.asana_task_gid = '1217133289235653';

    var finish = function () {
      panel.classList.add('is-done');
      if (window.ScrollTrigger) ScrollTrigger.refresh();
      if (WZ && WZ.smoother) WZ.smoother.scrollTo(panel, true, 'center center');
      else panel.scrollIntoView({ block: 'center' });
    };

    if (!LEAD_ENDPOINT) {
      console.info('[lead] would POST to GHL:', data);
      finish();
      return;
    }

    next.disabled = true;
    next.querySelector('span').textContent = 'Sending…';
    fetch(LEAD_ENDPOINT, {
      method: 'POST',
      headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' },
      body: JSON.stringify(data),
    })
      .then(function () {
        if (THANK_YOU_URL) { window.location.href = THANK_YOU_URL; return; }
        finish();
      })
      .catch(function () {
        next.disabled = false;
        next.querySelector('span').textContent = 'Request my free consultation';
        var slot = form.querySelector('[data-error-for="f-consent"]');
        if (slot) slot.textContent = 'Something went wrong. Please call the practice instead.';
      });
  }
})();
</script>
